'''bounty hunter6 LS Thone Mains''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 25 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 TRM hunter6 LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Cell 2187 (V) (Virtual Set 3), Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5), Scrambled Transmission (V) (Virtual Set 5): not in GEMP)

No objective pile that has few weaknesses...

== Notes ==

* Posted Cell 2137 (V) dested Cell 2187 (V) (Virtual Set 3); Slace Quarters dested Tatooine: Slave Quarters; Yavin 4: War Room dested Yavin 4: Massassi War Room; Unusual Amount Of Fear dested An Unusual Amount Of Fear.
* Posted EPP Chewie dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle; EPP Lando dested Lando With Blaster Pistol; Naked Threepio dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (the strategy pulls him with Shmi); R2 –D2 dested R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo).
* Duplicates as posted: Millennium Falcon x2, Owen Lars & Beru Lars x2 and R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) x2 are unique cards.
* Wokling is unmarked, so it is the printed card.

== Strategy ==

Didn't copy that much...just took 1 paragraph...revised it then posted it... I have alot of new cards...

General Strategy:

Play like any mains deck, but you usually generate 12-15 force on your second turn every game.

Pull the Home One Docking Bay (If they didnt start with a scomp link for you), and pull R2D2 (for free). You should have a How did we get into this mess?, so once you drop all your Sites. Mess the rest, and repeat. Since you go first, they will not have the force to grab the mess until after they activate thier first force. Hopefully, the dark side gave you a few force so you can Mess more, or even draw up if you dont get a Mess. On thier turn, after they pull the grabber shield, play another mess. You want them to grab it, so Harvest, Clash of Sabers can get through.

A gift is a good way to get the bounty hunting decks hurt.  You can get Shmi with Slave Quarters and then Threepio with her. Then pull Gift with Don’t do that again and move Threepio over to Audience Chamber… and then where they have an alien their drains are -1 and battle destinies are -2…

Organa and They Win This Round…nice retrieval if nessary

Matchups:

Senate: Let them drop the Baron to space first. Make sure you have a solid hold on the Moisture Farm, and wait for them to come at you.

Yet...icebreath you have at admit it is quite creative?
